preamble: Art for a 2D farming RPG. The first {refCount} attached images are APPROVED PANELS from this game's own art bible (a farmhouse on the board, a character, a farm animal, a decoration); copy their look exactly: a dark outline around every object; each object has a lit top plane and a shaded front; a soft contact shadow to the lower right (the light comes from the upper left); flat, confident fills with one shadow tone and one highlight per colour; small surface detail such as planks, stones, thatch and leaf clusters drawn as crisp shapes; warm ochre earth, clean saturated greens, bright daylight. Full resolution with smooth, crisp edges: NOT pixel art, no visible pixel grid, no dithering, no blur, no painterly texture. Camera for anything on the board: top-down three-quarter view on a square tile grid, roof planes and front faces both visible, verticals drawn straight up, never isometric. No text, no letters, no UI, no watermark, no frame.

variants.flatter: Shading: use fewer steps, exactly one shadow tone and one highlight per colour, and less surface detail; keep the dark outline.
